occamy_upstream_pytorch_2026_11_06.purpose: a third opinion: the GGUF is a conversion of the upstream safetensors, and llama.cpp is another port of the same architecture, so the upstream implementation shows where a port difference lives

occamy_upstream_pytorch_2026_11_06.reference: transformers 5.19.0, Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration, bfloat16 on the CPU, the engine's exact 19-token prompt

final_prefill_logits.reading: the two independent implementations differ from each other by more than the engine differs from llama.cpp, so the row-level spread is the port difference of a 37B sparse hybrid MoE, not an engine defect; the engine follows the GGUF contract, which is llama.cpp's

occamy_upstream_pytorch_2026_11_06.vision: dropped: the upstream tower is a Qwen3-VL style merger with its own position embedding interpolation and preprocessing, while the mmproj here is llama.cpp's CLIP tower, so the two are not comparable. For information only, the upstream features differ from the llama.cpp dump by relative L2 0.74595491, while this engine differs from the same dump by 0.00070317. The script can still produce the upstream dump (the vision tower wants the patchified sequence in (-1, C, temporal_patch, patch, patch) layout, 1024 rows of 1536 values for a 512x512 input)
occamy_upstream_pytorch_2026_11_06.limitation: the upstream reference runs the CPU fallback kernels (no causal_conv1d, no flash-linear-attention) and the BF16 weights, so it is a semantic reference, not a bitwise one

performance.reading: the engine's CPU decode is 17x the upstream PyTorch CPU decode (15.2 against 0.90 tok/s) because it reads only the eight active experts per layer in Q8_0 and uses the NEON kernels, while the reference runs transformers' fallback kernels without causal_conv1d or flash-linear-attention; on the GPU the reference is slightly ahead of the engine's device path (4.71 against 3.8 tok/s), and the engine's prefill is 4.4x faster (0.632 against 2.75 s)
performance.caveat: the PyTorch numbers are a floor, not an optimized reference: the reference implementations of causal_conv1d and chunk_gated_delta_rule are used, so an installed flash-linear-attention would move them

device_attention_2026_11_06.status: the vision tower's attention runs on the device: the patches attend in both directions over every patch, which the decoder-shaped device attention cannot express, so the tower uses the fused bidirectional kernel (src/vulkan/ops.rs AttentionRuntime, shaders/glsl/attention_online.comp) with F32 arithmetic, causal off and Gemma4's unit attention scale
device_attention_2026_11_06.residual_cause: the device F16 matmul rounds the activations to F16 (round_f16_rte, ggml parity) while the CPU F16 kernel converts only the weights and keeps the activations in F32, so the remaining gap is the CPU path's extra precision, not a device bug; the vision tower's attention itself is F32 on both sides
